description: Entity-resolution gold set: manually verified coreference clusters of entities that refer to the same real-world thing but were extracted as separate nodes. Each cluster's members are entity labels exactly as they appear in the graph. Built by inspecting the real entities, not synthetic.
source: data/graph.lbug (good-dog-corpus, ingested 2026-05-29; corpus YAML ontology with breed/organization/publication/concept/... types)
notes: Multi-member clusters only — these are the coreference cases a resolver must merge. Acronym<->expansion, singular<->plural, case/slug variants, and cross-type splits (the same org extracted as both 'organization' and 'concept'). Deliberately EXCLUDED as distinct referents: FDA vs FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine (sub-unit); APBT breed vs 'Pit Bull' type-category; Brucella canis (pathogen) vs brucellosis (disease); vitamin D (substance) vs vitamin D toxicity (condition); Hill's (company) vs Hill's Science Diet / Prescription Diet (products); city (location) vs City of <X> (municipal government).

_contrast_note: Distinct referents that must NOT merge into the coreference clusters above (or across contrast groups). The main B-Cubed score is over 'clusters' only; run_er_eval reports merge-violations against 'clusters' + 'contrast' together as a precision guard. APBT-breed vs pit-bull-category is already enforced as two separate entries in 'clusters'.
